posts.author: Yusefmv
posts.body:
Disclaimers: Game includes: Fake Religions, Fake Politics, and Romance and Alcohol and Tobacco references/use Pg-13/T for teen. No foul language
My current teaser/synopsis: Embark on a Dark Fantasy adventure of betrayal, love, and revenge? Begin your story (Project name: My Story: DarkBlood SaGa). You begin as a Demon of the lowest standing, in Demon society power is everything yet before your coming of age ceremony your powers are sealed! Get blamed for ruining the Noble Family's special order item, banished, and enter a temple to get your powers unlocked! You're not a hero in this game, you're a meddler. Summon a few followers, a demon nun who has a thing for maid clothing, a butler who has comically named yet effective skills, a banished dark elf ranger (not from forgotten realms inspired in the slightest) a sun elf paladin, and a fallen angel warlock. You're a demon and demons value power and seek it, and the freedom to do as they please. Get involved in a civil war between the Sun Elves and Dark Elves, unintentionally end a budding war between humans and the rest of the continent! Become an adventurer and gain reputation, fame, and... romance?!? Three different romance couples are in your party! Acquire your own domain and figure out who has been manipulating everything behi-underneath everything?? From demihuman barbarians to the Dwarves and Deep Dwarves I intend to have a world filled to the brim with things that only lead to progression of the story with side content being meaningful and impactful, adding to the immersion and lore. Main story events will have references to side plots.
Mechanics:
Crafting, Cooking, Building improvement, Kingcraft/Kingdom development, Sewing, Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Reputation by region which adds to a Global reputation system. Adventurers guild rank system (part required for story progression and full completion for Postgame), Fast Travel (limited by unlocked areas at adventurer guilds), Resource gathering (rng only for bonus items)
My challenges:
I am new to RPG Maker MV. I have already spent a couple hundred hours making 20 maps and figuring out how to use the various tools of the engine.
I am aware that my scope is massive for a newbie but I am a patient person and I finish what I start.
I am learning how to use editing software as I go (GIMP, Krita) and plugins (havent messed with more than Somerandevs menu plugin at this point)
I do not know javascript
I am open to any and all suggestions and criticism!
Video of the tutorial area map (incomplete missing music, sounds, encounters portraits and more)

posts.author: Ludovinsky
posts.body: World map is pretty cool. Good luck on your project. I've been learning for over 15 years. My game Terra Luma still isn't finished. Don't rush it, if you still have a lot to learn. Take your time, and love what you are doing or at least be devoted when you craft. If you want a criticism, it bothers me you are allergic to rug tiles.
